newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso still soft on dlr cover, long bond.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso still soft on dlr cover, long bond.

text.p: The peso was stable in mid-morning trade and had not extended early weakness, dealers said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart opened 1.55 and 0.75 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.8800/7.8900 and 7.8725/7.8825 per dollar.
The same-day peso meanwhile closed 1.8 centavos weaker at 7.8690/7.8730 per dollar.
Traders put peso weakness down to dollar covering by local dealers and demand from foreign investors in the wake of U.S. long-bond rates climbing.
Yields on the U.S. 30-year Treasury bond stood at 6.48 percent, compared to recent lows of 6.32 percent.
